method: Fresh full-body source review of exactly the 25 reserved TSX components, including all JSX, handlers, local helpers, hooks/effects, async continuation guards, confirmation binding, owner keys/remounts, drafts, resource refresh and receipt recovery. Parsed each complete TSX source with Rolldown and recorded function spans, all useEffect bodies, JSX event handlers/keys and API/action calls. Compared component behavior with the reviewed deployment/helper contracts where applicable; checked parent remount semantics directly in the assigned ExtensionsPanel/OrganizationPanel/TaskPanel and coordinated the external Settings integration with its owner. No tests or live UI were run. Finally compared every component hash to the frozen inventory and recomputed the full snapshot(undefined,true).
